profile.description: 2026 prospect with prior Adventure Zone outreach history from 2024. Event runs Sept. 14-18, 2026 in Richfield. Physical space at Richfield City Park is workable, but audience/flow fit is weaker for a full inflatable carnival because registered ATV/UTV participants leave for guided rides most mornings and return later; the strongest public gathering is Monday evening's farmers market/food truck/light parade. Treat as a secondary opportunity unless the organizer specifically sees a family/community attraction need.

notes.subject: Aug. 27 history-aware outreach / fit review
notes.body: Adventure Zone previously contacted Sevier Events about the Rocky Mountain ATV Jamboree in 2024 after Chad McWilliams supplied the contact. Desiree sent a new history-aware email Aug. 27, 2026 to Amy Myers / sevierevents@sevier.utah.gov. Official 2026 schedule confirms Sept. 14-18. Most participants leave City Park each morning on guided ATV/UTV rides; the main community-style window is Monday evening with the farmers market, food trucks and light parade. Do not over-prioritize this lead unless the organizer responds with a specific attraction opportunity.

followUps.label: Check Rocky Mountain Jamboree response
followUps.reason: History-aware email sent Aug. 27. Wait for a response. If none by Sept. 1, one light check-back is enough; this is a secondary fit because participant activity is primarily off-site trail riding rather than a stationary family festival.
